sentences.text: He has sought his release on bail.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3. It is argued that the applicant and Smt. Saraswati Devi were married some time in the month of September, 2020.
On 05.08.2022, Smt. Saraswati Devi was found missing from her house.
The applicant being the husband lodged a report to the Police.
He searched for his wife and visited his wife's father's house, but she was not traceable.
Subsequently, the father of Smt. Saraswati Devi filed a complaint that for dowry, Smt. Saraswati Devi was harassed and a case under Sections 498A and 304 IPC was lodged.
A skeleton was found about 400 meters far from the house of the applicant.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that other in-laws and brother-in-law of Smt.
Saraswati Devi have already been granted bail.
It is not a case of dowry death.
5. Learned State counsel would submit that it is a case of dowry death.
The applicant used to beat Smt. Saraswati Devi.
It is also submitted that Forensic Science Laboratory has not been received.
6. Fact remains that FIR was filed by the applicant himself.
Maichand, the brother in law of the applicant and other family members have already been released on bail.

8. The bail application is allowed.
9. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Court concerned.
